representation: Exact selected original values; dense animation samples and key-pose matrices remain in the original report in the Library source package.
scope: Blender-only; no UE import or acceptance
coordinate_system: Blender RH meters, +Z up, character faces -Y; row-major serialized matrices acting on column vectors; quaternion XYZW
measurement_limit: Contact frame closure alone is not surface collision proof. Separate measured hand/forearm surface samples and rendered multi-view review required.
constraint_implementation: Fixed weapon-local support relation solved analytically, then densely baked; no live IK constraint in this deliverable
cloth_clearance_issue: Frozen V2 has visible cape/sleeve penetration; this separate demo adds bounded corrective shape keys. Frozen character remains unchanged.

cloth_corrective.activation: Driver reads numeric property from the currently selected armature action; all other actions fallback to 0. Clip frames 1 through 97 inclusive activate at constant value 1, frame 0 and 98 off; no ramps or extrapolation.
cloth_corrective.scope: Only this grip demo copy; not a claim of all-original-character clothing clearance
cloth_corrective.driver_caveat: Updated explicit pose dependencies remove previously observed same-frame action-switch staleness; independently tested Idle/Grip/None with view_layer.update only, no frame_set. Blender 4.3.2 may still log the nested action ID-property registration warning; NLA/other applications not validated.
